name: flora_box_query
description: Derived by hand from flora 6.4.2 and 6.10.4 (test 37 of 16; FQ6). The occupant manager's 64 m index: cell(p) = rhe(f32(f32(p + 4096) * (1/64)) - 0.499f): cell(0) = 64, cell(63.93) = 64, cell(63.94) = 65, cell(64) = 65, cell(-0.5) = 63, cell(319.936) = 68 (the value rounds to exactly 68.5, half to even), cell(319.937) = 69. Listing: a box wider than 1 m on an axis is inset by 0.1f on that axis first: x 100 .. 101 (width 1.0) from cell(100); x 100 .. 102 from cell(100.1) to cell(101.9); x 63.9 .. 65.9 from cell(64.0) = 65, while x 63.9 .. 64.8 (0.9 wide) starts in cell(63.9) = 64; y plays no part. Query: the corners' cells clamped to 0..191, then a strict overlap on x, y and z: an occupant box x 10 .. 20 is not returned by a query ending at x 10 or starting at x 20, and is returned when the query ends at 10.000001. The listing window: Oak Tree clump 5's box (1717.9807, 319.84396) .. (1735.9807, 337.84396) is listed in x cells 90-91, z cell 69 (from 319.94396), so the block query z 288.1 .. 319.9 (z cell 68 only) does not return it although it overlaps, and the query z 320.1 .. 351.9 does. Cell queries (6.10.4): corners (10, 10)..(11, 11) give the world box (160.1, -FLT_MAX, 160.1) .. (191.9, +FLT_MAX, 191.9); corners (-5, 3)..(70, 3) in a 64 x 64 city are cells x 0..63, z 3..3; null corners are (0, 0)..(64, 64).
